name: rupturegrid-monorepo
description: RuptureGrid v1.0 — business-correctness failure testing platform (Phase 1 foundation)

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:apps
scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/api run build && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/demo-fintech run build && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/worker run build && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/web run build
scripts.lint: pnpm -r run lint && eslint tests packages/*/src/*.test.ts packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm web:typegen && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/worker run build && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.checks.json && tsc -p tsconfig.checks.ui.json
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/shared run build && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/config run build && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/control-db run generate && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/demo-db run generate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/control-db run migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter @rupturegrid/demo-db run migrate:deploy
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build
scripts.release:verify: pnpm verify && pnpm verify:integration && pnpm incident-zero:verify && pnpm controlled-faults:verify
scripts.verify:integration: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm test:integration
